description.en: An 8-bit game menu: a pixel font, stepped borders, a starry night sky, a blinking PRESS START and a chunky button that presses in. It loads the Press Start 2P font from Google Fonts. Organization admins can install it.
The button, the selected tab, links and the blinking line. Use a bright color: the text on it is dark.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&display=swap');
.login-background {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --background: 233 28% 14%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 96%;
  --card: 229 46% 30%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 96%;
  --popover: 229 46% 30%;
  --popover-foreground: 0 0% 96%;
  --muted: 233 28% 20%;
  --muted-foreground: 220 30% 80%;
  --accent: 233 28% 24%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 96%;
  --border: 0 0% 96%;
  --input: 0 0% 96%;
  --ring: 0 0% 96%;
  font-family: 'Press Start 2P', ui-monospace, 'Courier New', monospace;
  background-color: #1a1c2c;
  background-image: radial-gradient(#f4f4f4 1px, transparent 1.5px), radial-gradient(#94b0c2 1px, transparent 1.5px), radial-gradient(#f4f4f4 1.5px, transparent 2px);
  background-size: 170px 190px, 110px 130px, 290px 310px;
  background-position: 20px 30px, 70px 90px, 140px 60px;
}
@keyframes pixel-blink {
  50% {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 470px;
}

.login-panel {
  margin: 8px;
  width: calc(100% - 16px);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #29366f;
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 0 0 #f4f4f4, 0 8px 0 0 #f4f4f4, -8px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, 8px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, 0 0 0 8px #1a1c2c, 12px 12px 0 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.login-topbar button {
  color: #f4f4f4;
}
.login-form {
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.login-logo-box {
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}
.login-logo-box::after {
  content: '- PRESS START -';
  margin-top: 18px;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-size: 10px;
  animation: pixel-blink 1s steps(1) infinite;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  height: auto;
  padding: 2px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  overflow: visible;
}
.signin-methods [role='tablist'] {
  gap: 12px;
  overflow: visible;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  flex: none !important;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #1a1c2c !important;
  color: #94b0c2;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 -2px 0 0 #566c86, 0 2px 0 0 #566c86, -2px 0 0 0 #566c86, 2px 0 0 0 #566c86 !important;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: {{accentColor}} !important;
  color: #1a1c2c;
  box-shadow: 0 -2px 0 0 #f4f4f4, 0 2px 0 0 #f4f4f4, -2px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, 2px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4 !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #f4f4f4;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.8;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  margin: 4px;
  width: calc(100% - 8px);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #1a1c2c;
  color: #f4f4f4;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 11px;
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 0 0 #f4f4f4, 0 4px 0 0 #f4f4f4, -4px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, 4px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio'])::placeholder {
  color: #566c86;
  font-size: 8px;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 0 0 {{accentColor}}, 0 4px 0 0 {{accentColor}}, -4px 0 0 0 {{accentColor}}, 4px 0 0 0 {{accentColor}};
}
.login-password button {
  right: 6px;
  color: #94b0c2;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  margin: 0 4px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #1a1c2c;
  box-shadow: 0 -2px 0 0 #f4f4f4, 0 2px 0 0 #f4f4f4, -2px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, 2px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #1a1c2c;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form .login-button-box {
  padding: 4px;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #1a1c2c;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 400;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 0 0 #f4f4f4, 0 4px 0 0 #f4f4f4, -4px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, 4px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, inset -4px -4px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), inset 4px 4px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  filter: brightness(1.1);
}
.login-form .login-button:active {
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 0 0 #f4f4f4, 0 4px 0 0 #f4f4f4, -4px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, 4px 0 0 0 #f4f4f4, inset 4px 4px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-signup-link span {
  color: #94b0c2;
  font-size: 9px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
#footer {
  color: #94b0c2;
  font-size: 8px;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
